root.label: SFINAE & Concepts
root.note: Compile-time template constraints evolved from silent SFINAE substitution failures to ordered C++20 concept lattices.

children.label: SFINAE Rules
children.note: Invalid type or expression formation in a signature drops a candidate without failing the build.

children.label: Immediate Context
children.note: Template parameters, function parameters, return types, and explicit/noexcept clauses participate in SFINAE.

children.label: Hard Instantiation Errors
children.note: Failures inside instantiated helper class bodies or function bodies halt compilation immediately.

children.label: Expression SFINAE
children.note: Trailing decltype expressions verify member calls or operators without evaluating operands.

children.label: Pre-C++20 Idioms
children.note: Library patterns built explicit opt-in and trait detection on top of SFINAE.

children.label: std::enable_if
children.note: Produces a nested type only when a compile-time boolean condition evaluates to true.

children.label: Default Arg Signature Trap
children.note: Overloads differing only by a default template type argument collide as identical redeclarations.

children.label: std::void_t Detection
children.note: Maps valid type expressions to void to select specialized type traits cleanly.

children.label: if constexpr Branches
children.note: Discards untaken compile-time branches inside a single template body since C++17.

children.label: C++20 Syntax
children.note: Constraints evaluate before overload conversion sequences and yield clear diagnostics.

children.label: Named Concepts
children.note: Reusable compile-time boolean predicates that serve as shared atoms for subsumption.

children.label: Requires-Clauses
children.note: Attach compile-time boolean constraints on template heads or trailing member signatures.

children.label: Abbreviated Auto
children.note: Constrained auto parameters synthesize constrained function templates concisely.

children.label: Requires-Expressions
children.note: Evaluate syntactic validity of expressions and types at compile time, returning a bool.

children.label: Requirement Kinds
children.note: Inside a requires-expression, four distinct clauses check syntax, types, returns, and values.

children.label: Simple & Type
children.note: Verify that expressions compile and nested or specialized types exist without evaluating operands.

children.label: Compound Return Check
children.note: Enforce expression validity, optional noexcept guarantee, and return type concept satisfaction.

children.label: Nested Requires Trap
children.note: Omitting nested requires checks only whether a boolean trait expression compiles, not whether it is true.

children.label: Subsumption Ordering
children.note: Overlapping constrained templates resolve ambiguity through normalized atomic constraint inclusion.

children.label: Atomic Constraints
children.note: Constraints normalize down to source-located predicates paired with their template parameter mapping.

children.label: DNF and CNF Normalization
children.note: The compiler expands named concepts into conjunctions and disjunctions before comparing candidates.

children.label: More Constrained Wins
children.note: A candidate whose normalized constraints include all of another's wins overload resolution cleanly.
